title: Both of These Men Are About to Die #shorts
description:
Both of these men are about to die, and neither one will feel a thing.

November 5, 2005. A refinery in Delaware City, Delaware. A night-shift crew spots a roll of duct tape five feet down inside a reactor that has been pumped full of nitrogen. Doing it by the book means a permit and a delay. So they bend a wire into a hook.

Nitrogen is most of the air you are breathing. One or two breaths of it on its own and you black out, with no smell, no taste and no warning.

If someone goes down in a tank: do not go in after them. Call it in.

This is an animated reconstruction. Every fact in it comes from the U.S. Chemical Safety Board:
- Case Study 2006-02-I-DE, "Confined Space Entry - Worker and Would-be Rescuer Asphyxiated"
  https://www.csb.gov/valero-delaware-city-refinery-asphyxiation-incident/
- Safety Bulletin 2003-10-B, "Hazards of Nitrogen Asphyxiation"
  https://www.csb.gov/hazards-of-nitrogen-asphyxiation/

We tell these stories so no other family goes through this.
Don't die at work today.

Narration is an AI voice. The animation is a reconstruction, not footage.
